review_method: Read-only ZIP inventory and PDF text extraction with pypdf; archive member filenames use legacy encoding, so identity was established by document contents rather than displayed names.

contents.content: Assignment brief: Tkinter GUI, OOP classes, inheritance/polymorphism, menu and CRUD, plus report requirements.
Assignment brief: persistence, search, filtering, validation, and report requirements.

finding: The archive contains only the two assignment briefs. Their extracted text contains no student's group code, roster, personal record, approved title-page template, or other authoritative evidence to resolve the differing group codes in prior reports.
decision: Keep the existing report title-page codes unchanged. Treat the discrepancy as unresolved until checked against a current official roster or approved personal template.
privacy: The archive was inspected locally and read-only; no files were uploaded or modified.
